description: The plot illustrates the relationship between the number of queries used during inference and the Mean Reciprocal Rank at 10 (MRR@10) for different DPR (Dense Passage Retrieval) methods. The x-axis is labeled “Number of queries used during inference (S.)” and has a linear scale ranging from 1 to 10, with tick labels at each integer value. The y-axis is labeled “MRR@10” and has a linear scale ranging from 33.0 to 36.5, with tick labels at intervals of 0.5. A yellow line, representing “DPR w/ gold”, begins at approximately 33.3 when S is 1 and increases to approximately 36.1 when S is 10, with a generally upward trend. A green line, representing “DPR w/ top-1”, starts at approximately 33.1 when S is 1 and increases to approximately 34.8 when S is 10, with a generally upward trend. A purple line, representing “DPR w/ bottom-1”, begins at approximately 34.9 when S is 1 and decreases to approximately 34.7 when S is 10, with a generally downward trend. A blue line, representing “DPR w/ random”, starts at approximately 35.1 when S is 1 and remains relatively stable at approximately 35.1 when S is 10. A red line, representing “DPR w/ curriculum”, begins at approximately 35.4 when S is 1 and remains relatively stable at approximately 35.4 when S is 10.
